# Future Pathways

> Free career, course and university guides for school students and parents in India, written by career counsellor Madan Kumar PC. Every guide links to official sources, gives a short summary for parents, and lists the key dates for the current admission cycle. Facts are checked against official sites; each page shows when it was last updated.

Written by Madan Kumar PC, a CAP Accredited Counsellor and International Certified Career Coach (ICCC) and Cambridge Programme Coordinator in Tamil Nadu, India: https://pcmadankumar.github.io

Audience: students in Grades 6 to 12 (Indian boards and Cambridge IGCSE / AS & A Level) and their parents.

## Sections

- [Careers](https://futurepathways.github.io/careers/): what a career is, how to get into it and what to study.
- [Internships & Opportunities](https://futurepathways.github.io/opportunities/): internships, summer programmes, competitions and webinars, with deadlines.
- [Courses](https://futurepathways.github.io/courses/): degree courses and where they lead.
- [Countries](https://futurepathways.github.io/countries/): studying abroad, including costs, tests, visas and scholarships.
- [Universities](https://futurepathways.github.io/universities/): one university at a time, with entry rules, fees, dates and what parents should know. Includes the University Finder: a filterable table of 135 universities and colleges, 32 with a full profile here and the rest linking to their official websites.

## Most useful pages

- [University Finder](https://futurepathways.github.io/universities/): compare 135 universities and colleges in India and abroad by region, type, way in, cost and Cambridge A Level acceptance.
- [Upcoming Deadlines](https://futurepathways.github.io/deadlines/): every application deadline and key date on the site, soonest first.
- [Career Roadmaps](https://futurepathways.github.io/roadmaps/): 26 roles mapped to the school subjects to keep, Indian degrees and entrance exams.
- [Cambridge A Levels in India](https://futurepathways.github.io/courses/cambridge-a-levels-in-india/): equivalence, eligibility certificates, JEE, NEET and CUET, and how grades become a percentage.
- [For Parents](https://futurepathways.github.io/parents/): a starting point for parents.
- [Start here by grade](https://futurepathways.github.io/start/): what to do in Grades 6 to 8, 9 and 10, and 11 and 12.

## Notes

- Fees, dates and rules change every year. Each guide names the admission cycle it describes and links to the official page; check it before applying.
- Sitemap: https://futurepathways.github.io/sitemap-index.xml
